title: Lookup in an Injective Placement
statement: Let $k,l\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\iota$ be an injective map from the $k$ slots to the $l$ slots, and let a selection rule return slot $i$ exactly when the $l$-slot position is the image of $i$. For every position $j$ among the $l$ slots, searching the ordered list of the $k$ slots for the first $i$ with $\iota(i)=j$ returns precisely the selection rule's value at $j$ (and returns no value when there is no such $i$).
hypotheses_covered: A placement of the $k$ slots into the $l$ slots with its exact selection rule
